frequency_question: What proportion of emergency domestic co-production initiatives for complex missile systems achieve confirmed operational status within a tight multi-year deadline?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states attempting domestic assembly/manufacturing of foreign advanced tactical missiles under wartime/crisis conditions since 1990. Excludes simple ammunition, unguided weapons, or peacetime transfers.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic production of Stugna-P / Neptune variants
Taiwan domestic production of Hsiung Feng missiles under license/indigenous
South Korea domestic licensed production of tactical missiles
Georgia attempted domestic repair/production of aviation ordnance

coverage_note: 4 named cases representing major crisis-driven missile co-production efforts.
known_gaps: Classified or unsuccessful secret attempts in smaller states are under-reported.
skeleton: Total historical crisis co-production attempts of complex guided weapons vs those successfully operationalized and publicly verified within a compressed window.
validity_reason: Base rate reflects long-term defense industrial transfer dynamics during geopolitical crises.
